how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-uldaman-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:721:details:0: ⟦1⟧, can ye find him? Can you find Hammertoe in ⟦E2⟧?
rows.quest:721:details:1: If those dirty Shadowforge are holdin' him hostage to figure out what he knows about the titan excavations, then all of ⟦E3⟧ could be in huge trouble.
rows.quest:721:details:2: For a long time now those Dark Irons have been lookin' for magics to make more powerful golems. Hammertoe was doin' the same, of course, but only to stop them.
rows.quest:721:details:3: They're probably keepin' him alive until they learn what he knows.Ye've got to hurry if you're gonna save him!
rows.quest:721:completion:0: Yes? Ah'm sorry... ⟦2⟧ Feel so weak. Can ye come closer, ⟦3⟧?
rows.quest:721:completion:1: Ryedol sent ye? Muradin be praised, that boy's not as slow in the head as I once thought. ⟦4⟧
rows.quest:2418:obj:0: Bring 8 Dentrium ⟦E4⟧ and 8 An'Alleum ⟦E4⟧ to ⟦E5⟧ in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:2418:details:0: A while ago, I had an incident with the Shadowforge Dwarves. They brought me to Angor Fortress to study two types of strange stones from ⟦E2⟧. I discovered that the stones were sustained, stable power sources if treated correctly. It's amazing the things one can find in that old dig site!
rows.quest:2418:details:1: Anyway, after I told them the secret of the stones they kicked me out of Angor Fortress and began digging for more in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2418:details:2: I want those stones for myself! Bring me both types and I'll pay you plenty!
rows.quest:2418:progress:0: Do you have the power stones, ⟦5⟧?  I have a robotic rodent that needs a power supply...
rows.quest:2418:completion:0: That's great, you found some! Thanks a lot, ⟦6⟧. You're the most dependable ⟦7⟧ I've met!
rows.quest:2418:completion:1: I can't wait to try these on some devices I've been tinkering with. I bet that, under the right circumstances, devices powered with these stones will keep going, and going, and going...
rows.quest:704:obj:0: Bring 4 Carved Stone Urns to ⟦E8⟧ in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:704:details:0: The last report I received from Agmond is troubling, more so now that he's dead! He mentioned that his diggers uncovered "ancient urns" at the dig site outside ⟦E2⟧. I fear that the urns he found at that site incited the troggs, just as did the idols I found here.
rows.quest:704:details:1: I need you to get those urns for our studies. Go to the ⟦E2⟧ site, gather the urns, then return to me.
rows.quest:704:progress:0: Did you find those urns, ⟦8⟧? We must find the link between them and the troggs!
rows.quest:704:completion:0: Well done! With luck and diligence, we will find whatever link exists between the troggs and these ancient artifacts.
rows.quest:704:completion:1: You have done a great deed for the Prospectors, ⟦9⟧. Your efforts will not be forgotten. And neither will Agmond.
rows.quest:709:details:0: Oh my! Oh my! There is a doom approaching. Mark me! A doom!
rows.quest:709:details:1: No, I cannot speak of it...cannot utter their names or they may hear me! But if we learn, yes, if we learn more of them...then maybe we can learn how to foil them!
rows.quest:709:details:3: Go into ⟦E2⟧. No! I said it! You must find...find the tablet of...Ryun'eh. Yes, find it! And don't make me speak that name again!
rows.quest:709:details:4: It is deep in that place, in an ancient chest. That's where it hides...in a chest crafted before the works of any dwarf.
rows.quest:709:progress:0: Did you find the tablet? It must hold secrets! Secrets to save us!
rows.quest:709:completion:0: Oh, fortune is with us! Thank you! We may yet be saved!
rows.quest:722:obj:0: Find ⟦E13⟧ and return it to him in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:722:details:0: Ye're brave... ⟦10⟧... to come into ⟦E2⟧ fer me, ⟦11⟧.
rows.quest:722:details:1: If ye're really here to help... ol' Hammertoe, then... ⟦12⟧... you'll need to find... me amulet.
rows.quest:722:details:2: Deepshadow's got it... ⟦E14⟧. He's 'round here... in the ruins fer sure. That amulet'll lead 'em... ⟦13⟧... right to the scrolls if he ain't stopped. It's up to you, ⟦14⟧. Please... get that amulet.
rows.quest:722:details:3: The scrolls will surely help the Dark Irons create even more powerful golems. I just know it. I can feel it in me bones.
rows.quest:722:progress:0: The Shadowforge clan... ⟦15⟧ is dangerous. Be careful. ⟦16⟧ You must find the amulet.
rows.quest:722:completion:1: Ah knew you'd find me amulet, ⟦18⟧.
rows.quest:2240:obj:0: Read ⟦E15⟧'s Journal, explore the hidden chamber, then report to ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:2240:details:0: Now for the task at hand.
rows.quest:2240:details:1: There is a secret chamber, the Chamber of Khaz'mul, that must be explored. The problem is that the chamber's behind a huge, locked door! It's a lucky thing I know how to open it.
rows.quest:2240:details:2: I've described everything in my journal, here on the table. My band and I are stuck here for now... so you, ⟦22⟧, must find the chamber of Khaz'mul for us!
rows.quest:2240:details:3: Read my journal, explore the chamber, then report to ⟦E16⟧ at the Explorers' League in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2240:progress:0: Do you have something to report?
rows.quest:2240:completion:0: You have seen the Chamber of Khaz'mul? Amazing! ⟦E15⟧ was sure it existed, but I must admit that I had my doubts.
rows.quest:2240:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦23⟧. With luck your finding will incite our leaders to renew their efforts to retake ⟦E2⟧. And if it is ever again under ⟦E3⟧ control, then the secrets of the Chamber of Khaz'mul will be ours!
rows.quest:2398:details:0: The dig site at ⟦E2⟧ wasn't always overrun. We ⟦E3⟧ dwarves used to control the area, but... that was before the troggs came. They came so fast and in such numbers that not even dwarven might could stop them!
rows.quest:2398:details:1: In fact, their attack was so sudden that I fear some of our people may be trapped behind enemy lines.
rows.quest:2398:details:2: My friend ⟦E15⟧ led a small band of dwarves deep within the site just before the troggs showed up. If he and his company live, then I want you to find them.
rows.quest:2398:completion:0: It's about time you showed up! I was in danger of losing a bet with Olaf!
rows.quest:2398:completion:1: He wagered that his beard would grow to his knees before he saw another living ⟦24⟧. Well here you are, and as you can see Olaf's beard has a few more inches to go.
rows.quest:2398:completion:2: Thanks, ⟦25⟧. I'll split the winnings with you.
rows.quest:2198:obj:0: Search for the original creator of the shattered necklace to learn of its potential value.
rows.quest:2198:details:0: You have found a tarnished necklace, though the tarnish belies intricate and magical craftsmanship. The necklace has been shattered, as its setting appears to be missing three gems. On the underside of the necklace is the faint imprint of the city seal for ⟦E3⟧. Below the seal are three tiny, engraved letters: "TdK".
rows.quest:2198:details:1: If there is anything to be gleaned from the necklace, you will need to learn about its origins. Perhaps the seal and the initials are a start...
rows.quest:2198:progress:0: You've got the wrong gnome, pal! I was never there! You can't prove anything!⟦26⟧⟦27⟧Wait a second... who are you? What the... where did you find this necklace at?
rows.quest:2198:completion:0: Yes... I am the jeweler who made this necklace. I also am not in the business of handing out information as though it were free. Information is never free, friend. If I am going to help you out, you need to help ME out first.
rows.quest:2199:obj:0: Bring five silver bars to ⟦E19⟧ in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2199:details:0: I am a jeweler of great renown here in ⟦E3⟧! Well, former renown anyway... I have fallen onto hard times due to the chicanery of a competitor! A bad reputation in this business spells financial disaster. As a result, I find myself without a copper to my good-though-currently-sullied name.
rows.quest:2199:details:1: I want you to get me five silver bars to finish an order I received - the first in what seems like an eternity.
rows.quest:2199:details:2: You get me those five silver bars, and I'll answer your questions on the necklace.
rows.quest:2199:progress:0: Have you got the five silver bars I asked for?  I will share my sad tale of woe with you concerning the necklace you now possess... but only after I get those bars!  Please, help a gnome out, won't ya?
rows.quest:2199:completion:0: You're all right in my book; I don't care what everyone else has been saying... I kid, I kid! Seriously, thank you my friend.
rows.quest:2199:completion:1: Now, the necklace you have is one of my finest creations, but it is missing three gems that help bind magic power to it. I crafted it for a paladin some time ago. He was on a self-appointed quest to clear out the "evil taint" present at an excavation site in the ⟦E6⟧ called ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2199:completion:2: Well... that paladin died in ⟦E2⟧, and that was just the beginning of my woes.
rows.quest:2283:obj:0: Look for a valuable necklace within the ⟦E2⟧ dig site and bring it back to ⟦E20⟧ in ⟦E21⟧. The necklace may be damaged.
rows.quest:2283:details:0: We've got work for you, that is if you've got the guts to do it!
rows.quest:2283:details:1: Deep in the ⟦E6⟧ is the ⟦E2⟧ dig site. We've heard a tale about some idiot paladin who died there recently. Why we even care is that he had a very valuable necklace on him. It's supposedly got three large gems: a ruby, a sapphire, and a topaz.
rows.quest:2283:details:2: The shot: we want it, and we're payin' TOP SILVER to get it. It may be damaged, but that's neither here nor there; we'll fix whatever scratches are on it.
rows.quest:2283:progress:0: Well, do you have the necklace?  You won't see a copper from us if you don't have that necklace!
rows.quest:2283:completion:0: Mmmm salvage! I can smell the necklace from here. Now let's look at that beauty...
rows.quest:2283:completion:1: Hey, what do you think you're trying to do here? This necklace is missing the gems! You think we wouldn't notice? Even Malton could see that the gems are gone.
rows.quest:2283:completion:2: Well, maybe you didn't steal them... but this necklace is worthless without those gems! Your job isn't done here yet, not by a long shot!
rows.quest:2284:obj:0: Find a clue as to the gems' whereabouts in the depths of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2284:details:0: As sure as Malton is a dummy, those gems are still in ⟦E2⟧ somewhere. You're going to have to go back there and look for them.
rows.quest:2284:details:1: Like I said before, if the information we have is correct then there's a ruby, a sapphire, and a topaz that go with the necklace. Find them and put them in the necklace.
rows.quest:2284:details:2: As to where the gems are, who knows? Maybe you'll get lucky and find the corpse of the ⟦E22⟧. If he's not been stripped clean already, then maybe he's got them on him still.
rows.quest:2284:completion:0: You seem to have found the remains of the paladin that Dran had mentioned from before. Searching the remains uncovers what would appear to be his journal. The book is in poor condition, as dried blood has stained most of the text in the book. What you can read, however, is gibberish; it is written in the native tongue of the humans, to the best of your knowledge.
rows.quest:2284:completion:1: You will need the book translated if you are to glean any knowledge from it.
rows.quest:17:obj:0: Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to ⟦E23⟧ in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:17:details:0: I've heard about a newly discovered plant called the magenta fungus caps. They grow in clusters at the ⟦E2⟧ dig site and can be found in the early tunnels and deep within the less-explored areas. I want to study their potential use in alchemy, and that's where you come in.
rows.quest:17:details:1: Find the magenta cap clusters and bring me a dozen caps. Be warned, the clusters may spew out poison spores if jostled.
rows.quest:17:details:2: Do this for me, and I'll whip up a batch of one of my famous restorative elixirs for you!
rows.quest:17:progress:0: Have you obtained the magenta fungus caps I need for my alchemical work? No caps - no reward!
rows.quest:17:completion:0: Well done ⟦28⟧, you've proven your worth once again! The caps will be an interesting study, yon verily!
rows.quest:17:completion:1: And now, as promised, enjoy a taste of one of my more potent restorative brews from my personal stock...
rows.quest:17:completion:2: If you are a skilled alchemist, then perhaps we might have some additional business to conduct. Regardless, I thank you for your assistance!
rows.quest:2200:obj:0: Search for clues as to the current disposition of Talvash's necklace within ⟦E2⟧. The slain paladin he mentioned was the person who had it last.
rows.quest:2200:details:0: A competitor of mine started a rumor that my necklace cursed the paladin. Needless to say, no one wants to buy cursed items from a jeweler.
rows.quest:2200:details:1: B⟦29⟧, I'll make you a deal - find the gems and I'll reassemble the necklace, so long as you'll advertise that I do NOT make cursed items!
rows.quest:2200:details:2: Try looking for clues in ⟦E2⟧; maybe see if the paladin's body is down there, since he's the one who we know had it last! When you find the gems you should use this; it'll allow you to contact me here in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2200:completion:0: Remains of a paladin: Reading the journal reveals that after much effort, the paladin had identified the location of all three missing gems:
rows.quest:2200:completion:1: The Shadowforge dwarves hid the ruby in their barricaded area as they battled the Troggs for control of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2200:completion:2: The troggs stashed the topaz in an urn located near some unusual inhabitants of ⟦E2⟧ - ⟦E24⟧ dwarves!
rows.quest:2200:completion:3: Finally, the trogg elder himself took the sapphire as his own.
rows.quest:2202:obj:0: Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to ⟦E25⟧ in Kargath.
rows.quest:2202:details:0: I've heard about a newly discovered plant called the magenta fungus caps. They grow in clusters at the ⟦E2⟧ dig site and can be found in the early tunnels and deep within the less-explored areas. I want to study their potential use in alchemy, and that's where you come in.
rows.quest:2202:details:1: Find the magenta cap clusters and bring me a dozen caps. Be warned, the clusters may spew out poison spores if jostled.
rows.quest:2202:details:2: Do this for me, and I'll whip up a batch of one of my famous restorative elixirs for you!
rows.quest:2202:progress:0: Have you obtained the magenta fungus caps I need for my alchemical work? No caps - no reward!
rows.quest:2202:completion:0: Well done ⟦30⟧, you've proven your worth once again! The caps will be an interesting study, you betcha.
rows.quest:2202:completion:1: And now, as promised, enjoy a taste of one of my more potent restorative brews from my personal stock...
rows.quest:2202:completion:2: If you are a skilled alchemist, then perhaps we might have some additional business to conduct. Regardless, I thank you for your assistance!
rows.quest:2318:obj:0: Find someone who can translate the paladin's journal. The closest location that might have someone is Kargath, in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:2318:details:0: At an impasse of sorts, you know that you will need the book translated into a language you can understand. There certainly are a number of people in the world who could do it; the closest location that might have someone who could, however, is the Kargath outpost in the ⟦E6⟧. Perhaps that is a good place to start.⟦31⟧
rows.quest:2318:completion:0: Mighty ⟦32⟧, I know what you are doing out here in the ⟦E6⟧. I know you seek my gift of tongues. You're after the parts to that necklace you found in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2318:completion:1: Surprised? Don't be - it's my job to know such things. Instead, let's discuss what you're going to do for a translated journal. Trust me - I'm the only one you'll find that can translate it.
rows.quest:2318:completion:2: Better still, let me make you a better offer than ⟦E20⟧ is, and it'll let you still complete your deal with them. Interested now, yes?
rows.quest:2338:obj:0: Let Jarkal borrow the necklace. In exchange, he will translate the journal for you.
rows.quest:2338:details:0: Droffers and Son Salvage aren't smart enough to restore the magic in the necklace, but I am. All I want to do is study the necklace so I can learn to make them myself. To do that, I will need your necklace. Let me borrow it, and in exchange for the time I get to study it I will translate the journal for you. While you are searching for the gems, I should have enough time to learn what I need to.
rows.quest:2338:details:1: It's a simple deal, and no one else will be the wiser. Whatcha wanna do?
rows.quest:2338:progress:0: You've thought about it, yes? You're a smart ⟦33⟧ if you take this deal - you and I will get what we both want, and Droffers and Son Salvage will think they're getting what they want.
rows.quest:2338:completion:0: You know a good deal when you see one - I knew I could count on you.
rows.quest:2338:completion:1: It will be just a moment while I cast a spell to quickly translate the human tongue into a form you will understand. I am a troll of my word; ask anyone in the ⟦E28⟧ about ⟦E25⟧. Now, let's get this started...
rows.quest:1360:obj:0: Get ⟦E29⟧'s treasured possession from his chest in the North Common Hall of ⟦E2⟧, and bring it to him in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1360:details:0: I had myself a fine job as a digger at the ⟦E2⟧ excavation site in the ⟦E6⟧... that is until those blasted troggs showed up. I escaped with my hide barely intact, and nothing else. In the chaos, I left my most treasured possession. It's safe from the troggs in my chest, sure, but it's right in the thick of 'em.
rows.quest:1360:details:1: I'd be in your debt, both in honor and coin, if you could fetch it for me! A chest with my name on it is at the end of the North Common Hall. That's the one you need to get in.
rows.quest:1360:progress:0: Well now, we're you able to get slap around those troggs long enough to get into my chest and nab my treasure?
rows.quest:1360:completion:0: Ah, I feel complete again - thank you kindly.
rows.quest:1360:completion:1: Some dwarves may treasure the luster of metal, and some may treasure the glint of gems... but a Stoutarm without a treasured stein in hand is hardly a Stoutarm at all!
rows.quest:2201:obj:0: Find the ruby, sapphire, and topaz that are scattered throughout ⟦E2⟧. Once acquired, contact ⟦E19⟧ remotely by using the ⟦E30⟧ he previously gave you.
rows.quest:2201:obj:1: From the journal, you know...⟦34⟧* The ruby has been stashed in a barricaded Shadowforge area.⟦35⟧* The topaz has been hidden in an urn in one of the Trogg areas, near some ⟦E24⟧ dwarves.
rows.quest:2201:obj:2: B* The sapphire has been claimed by Grimlok, the trogg leader.
rows.quest:2201:details:0: The paladin's journal has provided perhaps the only clues that ⟦E2⟧ will yield as to the location of the necklace's gems. If the paladin's scribing remains accurate, then the Shadowforge dwarves and the troggs that vie for control of the dig site will need to be dealt with.
rows.quest:2201:details:1: Armed with this knowledge, the search for the gems begins in earnest. When all the gems have been acquired, Talvash in ⟦E3⟧ should be notified via the ⟦E30⟧ as per his instructions.
rows.quest:2201:progress:0: Talvash's image comes into focus from the waters of the scrying bowl.⟦36⟧⟦37⟧"Wow, you're still alive! Did you manage to find the gems? Are you truly the savior of my reputation I have hoped for? Please tell me you didn't waste a charge on the phial just to chat; those things are NOT cheap, and I'm already in dire financial straits."
rows.quest:2201:completion:0: Yep, those indeed are the three gems. Good job! Unfortunately, your work isn't quite over just yet.
rows.quest:2201:completion:1: No, I'm not trying to pull a fast one here, silly ⟦38⟧. This is about making magic jewelry - ⟦E19⟧ quality-level jewelry! You need a strong power source to give it some oomph. Well, that necklace has no more oomph to give.
rows.quest:2342:obj:0: Get ⟦E32⟧'s family treasure from their family chest in the South Common Hall of ⟦E2⟧, and bring it to him in the ⟦E33⟧.
rows.quest:2342:details:0: Sweeping the bat pens with this broom is not befitting a Garrett! I've earned a little coin from this accursed job, and I'm willing to spend it on you to better my station.
rows.quest:2342:details:1: The Garrett family weapon of choice is locked away in our chest in the South Common Hall of ⟦E2⟧ from when we Garretts toiled there as diggers. Without it, I will be stuck here forever - literally - sweeping up after these infernal bats.
rows.quest:2342:details:2: Reclaim my family's treasure and bring it to me! Help me restore my birthright!
rows.quest:2342:progress:0: The sweeping never ends... these bats are prolific in their mockery of me and my broom.  Please tell me you've reclaimed my family's treasure!  I've offered you my silver - is that not enough?!
rows.quest:2342:completion:0: At last - a broom worthy of a Garrett. You're bloody well worth every silver I spent on you, I say!
rows.quest:2342:completion:1: Do you hear me, foul bats? I now wield the Garrett family weapon of choice! Tremble, bats, tremble!!
rows.quest:2204:obj:0: Obtain a power source from the most powerful construct you can find in ⟦E2⟧, and deliver it to ⟦E19⟧ in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2204:details:0: You are going to need to find some "oomph" for the necklace, and ⟦E2⟧ is probably the best place for it, actually. I guess there are a lot of constructs running around in there, yeah? Well, take out the biggest, baddest construct in that place and grab its power source! I am pretty sure I can fuse that source into the necklace.
rows.quest:2204:details:1: Without that power source, fixing the necklace will be impossible. Come back to me here to ⟦E3⟧ when you have it, and we'll get it all fixed up for you!
rows.quest:2204:progress:0: You didn't even stop to tidy yourself up after leaving ⟦E2⟧, did you.  You just came straight here, lingering dungeon odors be damned.  Well, let's hope this visit is merely an odiferous one, and not a useless one to boot.⟦39⟧⟦40⟧Do you have the power source for the necklace?
rows.quest:2204:completion:0: Well I'll be - I sure am glad to see you and this power source in one piece. It will take me a moment to magically fuse the power source with the necklace now that the gems have been reunited with it. Once it is done, however, the necklace will be yours!
rows.quest:2204:completion:1: You're excited, aren't you? All tingly with anticipation? Now where did I put that spell focus at...
rows.quest:2339:obj:0: Recover all three gems and a power source for the necklace from ⟦E2⟧, and then bring them to ⟦E25⟧ in Kargath. Jarkal believes a power source might be found on the strongest construct present in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2339:obj:1: From the journal, you know...⟦41⟧* The ruby has been stashed in a barricaded Shadowforge area.⟦42⟧* The topaz has been hidden in an urn in one of the Trogg areas, near some ⟦E24⟧ dwarves.⟦43⟧* The sapphire has been claimed by Grimlok, the trogg leader.
rows.quest:2339:details:0: Here is the journal, translated for you to read on your own. The crux of it says dwarves hid the ruby, the troggs hid the topaz, and a trogg named Grimlok has the sapphire.
rows.quest:2339:details:1: Look - you're going to need a power source to make the necklace work again. ⟦E20⟧ doesn't know this. To find one, here's what I'd do: go as deep as you can in ⟦E2⟧ and kill whatever construct there is the strongest. No doubt whatever that is would have it.
rows.quest:2339:details:2: When you have everything collected, come back here!
rows.quest:2339:progress:0: You've got another trip into the depths of ⟦E2⟧ in store for yourself if you don't have the gems and a power source capable of channeling magical power back into the necklace.⟦44⟧⟦45⟧You'll be getting the gems back to deliver to the goons in ⟦E21⟧; I will be keeping the power source, since it will be the thing that will make the necklace work in the first place...
rows.quest:2339:completion:0: Very well done, ⟦46⟧. Now the fruits of our redirection will pay themselves out handsomely. I'm finished with the necklace itself, and I am confident I can duplicate the construction process consistently.

rows.quest:2341:completion:1: Here you go, my friend. I give you my thanks on a splendid job... and something quite special for your trouble.
rows.quest:2361:completion:0: I gladly give you this necklace, mighty ⟦47⟧. You have done me an invaluable service, and for that I thank you. Wear it with pride, and make sure you mention loudly and repeatedly who made it for you!

rows.quest:2278:details:2: You have uncovered a wealth of previously undiscovered worldly lore!
rows.quest:2278:progress:0: The voice of the stone watcher seems to resonate within your very inner being:⟦52⟧⟦53⟧"You must first satisfy the data assimilation prerequisite of Discs of Norgannon; once you fulfill this requirement, you will then be permitted to obtain a portable version of the stored data. rows.quest:2278:completion:1: B"The discs have now been synthesized. Access the Discs of Norgannon once more to receive your personal copy."
